name: Taking Action
overview: Scripture calls believers to active faith, emphasizing that God invites us to ask, seek, and knock with the assurance that He will respond (Luke 11:9). We are created in Christ Jesus for good works which God has prepared for us to walk in (Ephesians 2:10), and we are exhorted to be strong in the Lord’s power as we carry out His purposes (Ephesians 6:10). Genuine faith is demonstrated by doing the Word and serving wholeheartedly as unto the Lord, not merely hearing or observing without action (James 1:22; Colossians 3:23).
